title: Stranger Sharing Calculator: small talk vs oversharing
subtitle: Smart boundaries in casual chats — on flights, in queues, at networking, or in DMs.
seoDescription: Free stranger-sharing calculator by place, counterpart, and goal. Quick or 30-question deep quiz with specific answers, privacy score, and practical tips — in your browser.
heroDescription: Small talk can be pleasant — or reveal too much. This tool helps mark the line between warmth and oversharing, tuned to the scene and who you’re talking to.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: You set where the chat happens, who the other person is, and your goal — then pick a quick or full quiz.
Questions cover real dilemmas: work crises, politics, prying questions, and gut checks.
The report scores privacy guard, social grace, and gut instinct — with practical tips.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Fill the setup, choose quiz length, and answer with a clear progress bar.
Save to history (Expand on the home grid) or download a result card.
Use the result as a compass — not a verdict on your personality.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Oversharing often comes from politeness or silence-filling — not malice.
Clear boundaries protect privacy without killing a pleasant conversation.

benefits.title: Scene-tuned
benefits.description: Place, counterpart, and goal shape the questions.

benefits.title: Two lengths
benefits.description: Quick boundary check or full social dynamics.

benefits.title: Witty tips
benefits.description: Elegant exits, detail filters, and warm guardrails.

faq.question: Does this mean being cold?
faq.answer: No. The goal is warmth with a fence — not disconnection.

faq.question: What if I already overshared?
faq.answer: The report helps spot patterns and practice elegant exits next time.

faq.question: Is data stored on a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs and saves locally in the browser.
